identity_reason: it is Input inside InputGroup with two IconButtons, so its groove, focus and press come from those parts
concept: A number field with minus and plus inside one groove; it is a spinbutton for the keyboard and holds typed numbers to its limits.

input.why: the number is centred in tabular figures so it does not jump as it steps

end.why: the unit and the plus sit together at the end with a small gap between them

unit.why: the unit is in the secondary tone at label size so the number leads

glyph.why: minus and plus are drawn with the ring stroke so they read at a glance
